defense_news.title: Steam catapults? US Navy appears to be sticking with electromagnetics on carriers
defense_news.summary: Despite an August order for the U.S. Navy to return to steam catapults on its newest carriers, the service appears to be sticking with electromagnetics.

defense_news.title: Air Force, civilian staff dispute status of China Aerospace Studies Institute
defense_news.summary: CASI's director said the move will effectively end the institute, even as the service says CASI’s mission will continue.

defense_news.title: Greenland welcomes US military pact but trust still shaky
defense_news.summary: Greenland’s government and residents expressed relief about a new military pact with the United States and Denmark.

defense_news.title: German defense minister sees smooth sailing in parliament for his record defense budget
defense_news.summary: Pistorius is asking lawmakers to approve nearly €140 billion ($160 billion) for defense next year, a record sum.
